pressure_note: not stated beyond 'Atmospheric pressure changes were usually insignificant during an experiment'; dilatometer at ambient pressure; partial molal volume at low gas concentration

volume_basis_evidence: Column headed 'Molarity'; the paper does not say litres of solution or solvent

notes: Gas is Ar, CH4, C2H6, O2 or H2 per row (column 'Solute gas'); Ar rows are outside the seven-gas list. Printed '+/-' split into the std dev column. Standard conditions for gas volumes not applicable. Partial molal volume of dissolved gas, not a solubility.

gas_from_column.note: continuation cells blank in print, filled down in the CSV
